# Official Stasis Zone Modpack

**Version:** 1.0.0 | **Minecraft:** 1.20.1 | **Loader:** Fabric 0.18.4 | **Mods:** 98

[Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/modpack/stasis-modpack) · [Discord](https://discord.gg/bm2GdzcuGX) · [stasis.zone](https://stasis.zone)

---

## What is Stasis Zone?

This is the **official modpack for [stasis.zone](https://stasis.zone)'s Vision SMP**. It's heavily **Create-focused**, built on Minecraft 1.20.1 with the Fabric loader, and revolves around the iconic **Create mod** and its enormous ecosystem of addons — delivering a cohesive, mechanical, and industrial survival experience purpose-built for the Vision SMP's world.

Whether you're building automated train networks, launching cannon shells across the map, constructing flying ships with Valkyrien Skies, or decorating your base with custom furniture — Stasis Zone has it all.

The pack is carefully curated to balance **content depth**, **visual quality**, and **performance**, featuring 98 mods plus handpicked resource packs including Fresh Animations for a polished, immersive feel right out of the box.

**Join the community:** [discord.gg/bm2GdzcuGX](https://discord.gg/bm2GdzcuGX)

---

## Key Features

- 🔧 **Create Ecosystem** — The most expansive Create addon collection available, covering trains, cannons, missiles, jetpacks, enchantments, food, aquatics, and more
- 🚂 **Advanced Railways** — Steam 'n' Rails, Railways Navigator, Train Perspective, and Track Map for a full-featured train experience
- 🛸 **Valkyrien Skies** — Build functional, physics-based airships and moving contraptions of any size
- ⚔️ **Big Cannons & Missiles** — Industrial-scale weapons for server warfare or creative destruction
- 🌿 **World Enrichment** — Biomes O' Plenty and TerraBlender for stunning new landscapes
- 🏗️ **Building & Decoration** — Create Deco, Design Decor, Interiors, Immersive Furniture, and CopyCats+ for incredible builds
- 🐾 **Fresh Animations** — Full Fresh Animations suite pre-installed with entity model/texture features for living, breathing mobs
- 🗺️ **Live Map** — BlueMap integration with Create support for a real-time server map
- ⚡ **Optimized** — Sodium, Lithium, ModernFix, FerriteCore, EntityCulling, ImmediatelyFast, Dynamic FPS, and more

## Getting Started

### Installation via Modrinth App (Recommended)

1. Download and install the [Modrinth App](https://modrinth.com/app)
2. Click **Browse** and search for `Stasis Modpack`
3. Hit **Install**, then **Play**

### Manual Installation (.mrpack)

1. Install [Prism Launcher](https://prismlauncher.org/) or any compatible launcher
2. Click **Add Instance → Import from .mrpack**
3. Select the downloaded `.mrpack` file and launch

### Recommended Settings

- **RAM:** 6–10 GB allocated (8 GB recommended for the Vision SMP)
- **Java:** Java 17 or 21, 64-bit
- **Render Distance:** 8–12 chunks

## Mod List (98 Mods)

- **Create Missiles** — Craft and launch guided missiles with fully destructible physics
- **Create: Interactive** — Interactive contraption elements like levers and buttons on moving parts
- **Create Jetpack** — A pneumatic jetpack powered by Create's air pressure systems
- **Create: Enchantment Industry** — Automate enchanting and disenchanting using Create machinery
- **Create: Enchantable Machinery** — Apply enchantments directly to Create machines for enhanced performance
- **Create: Steam 'n' Rails** — Massively expands the train system with new engines, bogeys, and track types
- **Create: Railways Navigator** — In-game train schedule and navigation UI for complex rail networks
- **Create: Train Perspective** — First-person and improved camera perspectives while riding trains
- **Create: Track Map** — Real-time in-game map of your entire railway network
- **Create: Bells & Whistles** — Cosmetic and functional train decorations, horns, and embellishments
- **Escalated** — Adds escalators and moving walkways powered by Create
- **Create Addition** — Electrical components bridging Create's rotational power and everyday machines
- **Create Utilities** — A collection of handy Create-compatible utility blocks
- **Create Goggles** — Enhanced engineer's goggles with extra information overlays
- **Create Deco** — Hundreds of decorative blocks matching Create's industrial aesthetic
- **Create: Ultimate Factory** — Advanced factory machines that supercharge large-scale production
- **Create: High Pressure** — High-pressure pipes and fluid management for advanced builds
- **Create: Aquatic Ambitions** — Underwater Create content: submarine contraptions and oceanic machinery
- **Create: Food** — Automate food production with Create-powered farms and kitchens
- **Create: Cobblestone** — Automated cobblestone generation and processing solutions
- **Create Copper and Zinc** — Extra decorative and functional uses for copper and zinc
- **Create: Spawner Boxer** — Capture and relocate mob spawners using Create contraptions
- **Create: Armor Trims** — Craft and automate armor trims using Create machinery
- **Create Trimmed** — Additional armor trim patterns compatible with Create workflows
- **Create: Contraption Terminals** — Add interactive terminals to contraptions for remote control
- **Create: Contraption Creatures** — Summon and interact with mobs from within Create contraptions
- **Create: Renewable Brass** — Alternative recipes to produce brass through renewable resource chains
- **Create Oxidized** — Mechanics and aesthetics around copper oxidation for Create builds
- **Create: Colored** — Colored variants of Create's blocks and components

- **Molten Metals** — Smelting and metalworking expansions that integrate with Create
- **Slice and Dice** — Integrates Farmer's Delight with Create's mechanical processing

### 🛸 Physics & Movement

- **Valkyrien Skies** — Full physics engine allowing ships, airships, and any structure to fly or float with realistic momentum and collision

### 🌍 World Generation

- **Biomes O' Plenty** — Dozens of new biomes ranging from lush tropics to volcanic wastelands
- **TerraBlender** — Biome blending library ensuring all modded biomes integrate smoothly with the vanilla world

### 🍎 Food & Farming

- **Farmer's Delight** — Expands the food system with new crops, cooking mechanics, and comfort food recipes
- **Trading Floor** — Adds market stalls and trading mechanics for player-run economies

### 🏗️ Building & Decoration

- **Create Deco** — Industrial decorative blocks perfectly matching Create's aesthetic language
- **Design Decor** — Elegant decorative blocks for more refined interior and exterior builds
- **Interiors** — Functional and decorative furniture pieces for detailed room building
- **Immersive Furniture** — A wide catalog of placeable furniture items with detailed models
- **CopyCats+** — Special blocks that copy the appearance of any other block, perfect for blending styles
- **Create: Stones** — Stonework and masonry blocks designed to complement Create builds

### 🗺️ Maps & Navigation

### 🐾 Visual & Animation

- **Entity Model Features** — Allows resource packs like Fresh Animations to add custom entity models
- **Entity Texture Features** — Enables per-entity texture variation for richer mob appearances
- **Skin Layers 3D** — Renders the outer skin layer as an actual 3D shell on all players
- **Chat Heads** — Shows player head avatars next to chat messages in the chat window
- **Continuity** — Seamless connected textures for glass, bookshelves, and more
- **Model Fix** — Fixes minor model rendering artifacts across various blocks and items
- **Iris** — Shader loader compatible with Sodium, enabling full shaderpack support
- **FabricSkyboxes** — Custom skybox support for Dramatic Skies and similar resource packs

### ⚡ Performance

- **Sodium** — The gold-standard rendering optimization mod for Fabric
- **Lithium** — Server-side game logic optimizations for ticks, pathfinding, and physics
- **ModernFix** — Broad startup time and memory usage improvements
- **FerriteCore** — Dramatically reduces RAM usage via deep memory optimization
- **Entity Culling** — Skips rendering entities not in the player's line of sight
- **ImmediatelyFast** — Optimizes immediate-mode rendering for UI and entities
- **Dynamic FPS** — Reduces resource usage when the game window is minimized or unfocused
- **Sodium Extra** — Additional Sodium options including animation and particle toggles
- **Reese's Sodium Options** — Redesigned Sodium settings menu for easier configuration

### 🖥️ UI & Quality of Life

- **JEI (Just Enough Items)** — The definitive recipe viewer: look up any crafting recipe or item usage instantly
- **Jade** — Shows what you're looking at with detailed block and entity tooltips
- **AppleSkin** — Displays food saturation and hunger restore values in the HUD
- **Clumps** — Merges nearby XP orbs into single large orbs to reduce entity lag
- **Vein Miner** — Mine entire ore veins with a single swing using a keybind
- **Zoomify** — Smooth, configurable zoom with optional cinematic easing
- **Controlling** — Improved keybinding search and conflict detection in the controls menu
- **Searchables** — Adds a search bar to many in-game lists and menus
- **Mod Menu** — Browse and configure all installed mods from a clean in-game menu
- **No Chat Reports** — Strips signing from chat messages, preventing Mojang chat reporting
- **Tom's Simple Storage** — Compact, network-based storage solution with easy item management
- **Totem Factory** — Automates totem crafting and magical item production

### 🔧 Libraries & Dependencies

These mods are required by others to function and don't add direct gameplay content.

- **Fabric API** — Core Fabric mod API required by nearly all Fabric mods
- **Fabric Language Kotlin** — Kotlin language support for Fabric mods
- **Architectury API** — Cross-platform mod library used by several addons
- **Cloth Config API** — Configuration screen library
- **YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL)** — Modern config UI library
- **Fzzy Config** — Additional configuration utilities
- **Moonlight Lib** — Shared utility library for several content mods
- **Silk** — Kotlin-based Fabric utility library
- **GlitchCore** — Core library for certain rendering mods
- **AzureLib** — Animation and model library
- **DragonLib** — Library for dragon and entity animation mods
- **Ritchie's Projectile Lib** — Shared projectile physics library for weapons mods
- **Placeholder API** — Text placeholder and variable library
- **Create Sodium Fix** — Compatibility patch between Create and Sodium
- **Realism** — Physics and realism tweaks library

- **FA+ Player v1.0** — Fresh Animations extension adding new player animations
- **FA+ Creepers v2.1** — Fresh Animations variant specifically for Creeper models
- **FA+ Emissive v1.5** — Adds glowing emissive textures to mobs for a dramatic look
- **FA+ Objects v2.1** — Animated item and object models to match Fresh Animations style
- **Dramatic Skies Demo** — Stunning dynamic sky textures with volumetric clouds and sunsets

Entity Model Features and Entity Texture Features are included so Fresh Animations works perfectly with zero extra setup.

## Notes & Compatibility

- Requires **Java 17** or newer — Java 21 is recommended for best performance
- Minimum **6 GB RAM** allocated; 8 GB recommended, especially when connected to the Vision SMP
- Shader support via **Iris** — download compatible shaderpacks from Modrinth and place them in your `shaderpacks` folder
- **Valkyrien Skies** contraptions with many blocks may impact server TPS — keep ship sizes reasonable in multiplayer
- **BlueMap** renders incrementally — your full web map may take time to appear after first launch
